نستئم (form X)
# نَسْتَئِمُّ (nastaʔimmu) /nas.ta.ʔim.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# نَسْتَئِمَّ (nastaʔimma) /nas.ta.ʔim.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# نَسْتَئِمِّ (nastaʔimmi) /nas.ta.ʔim.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
